[EN] Stop!

There is no need for violence. There is another way.
[ES] ¡Alto!

No hay necesidad de violencia. Hay otra manera.

[EN] Your will is strong. Shandra Manaya needs strength.

Walk away and we will spare you. Walk away and when we rule, you will serve us."And what's that?""Oh, I don't think so!"
[ES] Tu voluntad es fuerte. Shandra Manaya necesita fuerza.

Aléjate y te perdonaremos. Aléjate y cuando gobernemos, nos servirás."And what's that?""Oh, I don't think so!"
